run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
build_GTNLossFunction: build a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence alignment loss computation
create_make_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
review_forward_backward: review the forward and backward methods of GTNLossFunction that use gtn.parallel_for for batched graph scoring
test_GTNLoss_end_to_end: test the GTNLoss end-to-end by computing loss and gradients on random batched inputs and targets
